### P8 "Pixel Sort" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: Pixel sort glitch effect. Shifts pixels along rows or columns based on brightness, creating the distinctive glitch art look. Pixels above the threshold are displaced in the sort direction proportional to their brightness.
